knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The report must draw a conclusion about validity and state the limits of the method.
The source expects review or repeat after such changes, not on a fixed daily basis.
Entries written as the event happens show what really occurred. Later recollection is unreliable.

practicalCriteria: Learner writes a one-paragraph conclusion for a practice study, with at least one limitation (pass: conclusion and limitation both present).
Learner records a practice cleaning event at the time it is carried out (pass: time, agent and person recorded).
Learner lists three changes and marks each as review, repeat or no action, with a reason (pass: all three decided with reasons).
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: A report is about to be signed without a conclusion.
A cleaning event is being recorded from memory after the fact.
A change to the agent or procedure is about to be used before a review.
